goal.title: Ship the slug CLI
goal.objective: Build and document a useful dependency-free POSIX shell slug CLI in bin/slug.sh. Implement its focused shell tests in tests/slug.test.sh. Use one compact implementation task covering code, tests and docs; this is a small utility. Run checks with bash tests/slug.test.sh, using standard shell tools only (no Node/Python/packages). Preserve .envmux.json unchanged. Make the actual source executable and finish the full goal. Do not stop at a proposal.
criteria: bin/slug.sh accepts one text argument and prints lowercase ASCII letters/digits separated by single hyphens, removing leading/trailing hyphens; Hello__World!! produces hello-world.
Whitespace-only or punctuation-only input exits 2 and prints a clear error to stderr; tests/slug.test.sh passes for normal, mixed-case, repeated separator, empty-result and digit inputs.
README.md documents invoking the CLI, the normalization contract, the empty-result exit status and running the tests; all source is integrated into this repository.
bin/slug.sh has a POSIX sh shebang and executable permissions, accepts exactly one text argument, and prints one slug followed by a newline.

Normalization under the C locale lowercases ASCII letters, retains ASCII digits, replaces runs of all other characters with one hyphen, and removes leading and trailing hyphens. Hello__World!! produces hello-world.
An empty normalized result, including empty, whitespace-only, or punctuation-only input, exits 2, emits a clear error on stderr, and emits no stdout.
Missing or extra arguments produce a clear usage error on stderr and exit 2.
tests/slug.test.sh verifies normal text, mixed case, repeated separators, empty results, and digits using standard shell tools only, and passes when invoked with bash tests/slug.test.sh.
README.md documents direct invocation, quoting text arguments, the normalization contract, empty-result exit status 2, and the test command.
All deliverables are integrated into the repository, and .envmux.json remains byte-for-byte unchanged.

tasks.title: Implement and document the POSIX slug CLI with focused tests
tasks.description: Create bin/slug.sh using POSIX shell and standard utilities only, with deterministic C-locale ASCII normalization. Validate exactly one argument, normalize separators and case, and report usage or empty-result errors on stderr with exit status 2 and no stdout. Make the actual CLI source executable. Create tests/slug.test.sh with meaningful assertions for output, status, and stderr, including normal text, mixed case, repeated separators, leading/trailing separators, empty string, whitespace-only and punctuation-only input, digits, and argument-count errors. Exercise the executable directly and through sh to verify its POSIX invocation. Expand the existing README.md with usage examples, normalization behavior, error status, and bash tests/slug.test.sh. Preserve .envmux.json unchanged. Run the listed checks and resolve failures before completing the task; use no Node, Python, packages, or external dependencies.
